name: Sweden
dossier:
The Sweden national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Blågult, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 38 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Scandinavian powerhouses carrying a golden generation of dynamic, clinical attackers.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Sweden will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group F and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group F. The connection between Alexander Isak and Dejan Kulusevski is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Alexander Isak - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Sweden are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Sweden reached the quarter-finals in 2018 and boast a frighteningly potent attack for 2026.
Sweden boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Runners-up (1958).
